records.source: A 58-year-old African-American woman presents to the ER with episodic pressing/burning anterior chest pain that began two days earlier for the first time in her life.
records.translation: 一名58歲非裔美籍女性因陣發性壓迫感／灼熱感前胸痛至急診就醫，此疼痛於兩天前開始，為其生平第一次發作。
records.back_translation: A 58-year-old African-American woman came to the emergency department for paroxysmal pressure/burning anterior chest pain; this pain began two days ago and is the first episode in her life.

records.source: The pain started while she was walking, radiates to the back, and is accompanied by nausea, diaphoresis and mild dyspnea, but is not increased on inspiration.
records.translation: 疼痛於行走時開始，會放射至背部，並伴隨噁心、冒冷汗及輕微呼吸困難，但吸氣時疼痛不會加劇。
records.back_translation: The pain began while walking, radiates to the back, and is accompanied by nausea, cold sweating and slight dyspnoea, but the pain does not worsen on inspiration.

records.source: The latest episode of pain ended half an hour prior to her arrival.
records.translation: 最近一次疼痛發作於抵達急診前半小時結束。
records.back_translation: The most recent episode of pain ended half an hour before arriving at the emergency department.

records.source: She is known to have hypertension and obesity.
records.translation: 已知有高血壓及肥胖病史。
records.back_translation: Known history of hypertension and obesity.

records.source: She denies smoking, diabetes, hypercholesterolemia, or a family history of heart disease.
records.translation: 患者否認抽菸、糖尿病、高膽固醇血症或心臟病家族史。
records.back_translation: The patient denies smoking, diabetes, hypercholesterolaemia or a family history of heart disease.

records.source: She currently takes no medications.
records.translation: 目前未服用任何藥物。
records.back_translation: Currently not taking any medication.

records.source: Physical examination is normal.
records.translation: 理學檢查正常。
records.back_translation: Physical examination normal.

records.source: The EKG shows nonspecific changes.
records.translation: 心電圖顯示非特異性變化。
records.back_translation: ECG shows nonspecific changes.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: An 8-year-old male presents in March to the ER with fever up to 39 C, dyspnea and cough for 2 days.
records.translation: 一名8歲男童於三月因發燒（最高達39 C）、呼吸困難及咳嗽2天至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: An 8-year-old boy came to the emergency department in March for fever (up to 39 C), dyspnoea and cough for 2 days.

records.source: He has just returned from a 5 day vacation in Colorado.
records.translation: 他剛從科羅拉多州5天的度假旅行返家。
records.back_translation: He has just come home from a 5-day holiday trip in the State of Colorado.

records.source: Parents report that prior to the onset of fever and cough, he had loose stools.
records.translation: 家長表示在發燒及咳嗽出現之前，他有稀便情形。
records.back_translation: The parents say that before the fever and cough appeared, he had loose stools.

records.source: He denies upper respiratory tract symptoms.
records.translation: 病童否認有上呼吸道症狀。
records.back_translation: The child denies upper respiratory tract symptoms.

records.source: On examination he is in respiratory distress and has bronchial respiratory sounds on the left.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現病童呈呼吸窘迫，左側可聞支氣管呼吸音。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds the child in respiratory distress; bronchial breath sounds can be heard on the left.

records.source: A chest x-ray shows bilateral lung infiltrates.
records.translation: 胸部X光顯示兩側肺部浸潤。
records.back_translation: Chest X-ray shows bilateral lung infiltrates.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 58-year-old nonsmoker white female with mild exertional dyspnea and occasional cough is found to have a left lung mass on chest x-ray.
records.translation: 一名58歲不抽菸的白人女性，有輕度運動性呼吸困難及偶發咳嗽，胸部X光發現左肺腫塊。
records.back_translation: A 58-year-old non-smoking white woman with mild exertional dyspnoea and occasional cough; chest X-ray finds a left lung mass.

records.source: She is otherwise asymptomatic.
records.translation: 除此之外並無其他症狀。
records.back_translation: Apart from this there are no other symptoms.

records.source: A neurologic examination is unremarkable, but a CT scan of the head shows a solitary mass in the right frontal lobe.
records.translation: 神經學檢查無明顯異常，但頭部電腦斷層顯示右側額葉有單一腫塊。
records.back_translation: Neurological examination without notable abnormality, but head CT shows a single mass in the right frontal lobe.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 2-year-old boy is brought to the emergency department by his parents for 5 days of high fever and irritability.
records.translation: 一名2歲男童因高燒及躁動不安5天，由父母帶至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: A 2-year-old boy was brought by his parents to the emergency department for high fever and irritability for 5 days.

records.source: The physical exam reveals conjunctivitis, strawberry tongue, inflammation of the hands and feet, desquamation of the skin of the fingers and toes, and cervical lymphadenopathy with the smallest node at 1.5 cm.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現結膜炎、草莓舌、手腳發炎、手指及腳趾皮膚脫屑，以及頸部淋巴結腫大，最小的淋巴結為1.5 cm。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds conjunctivitis, strawberry tongue, inflammation of hands and feet, desquamation of finger and toe skin, and cervical lymph node enlargement, the smallest node 1.5 cm.

records.source: The abdominal exam demonstrates tenderness and enlarged liver.
records.translation: 腹部檢查發現壓痛及肝臟腫大。
records.back_translation: Abdominal examination finds tenderness and liver enlargement.

records.source: Laboratory tests report elevated alanine aminotransferase, white blood cell count of 17,580/mm, albumin 2.1 g/dL, C-reactive protein 4.5 mg, erythrocyte sedimentation rate 60 mm/h, mild normochromic, normocytic anemia, and leukocytes in urine of 20/mL with no bacteria identified.
records.translation: 檢驗報告顯示丙胺酸轉胺酶（ALT）上升、白血球計數17,580/mm、白蛋白2.1 g/dL、C反應蛋白4.5 mg、紅血球沉降速率60 mm/h、輕度正色素正球性貧血，以及尿液白血球20/mL且未發現細菌。
records.back_translation: Lab report shows raised alanine aminotransferase (ALT), white cell count 17,580/mm, albumin 2.1 g/dL, C-reactive protein 4.5 mg, ESR 60 mm/h, mild normochromic normocytic anaemia, and urine white cells 20/mL with no bacteria found.

records.source: The echocardiogram shows moderate dilation of the coronary arteries with possible coronary artery aneurysm.
records.translation: 心臟超音波顯示冠狀動脈中度擴張，可能合併冠狀動脈瘤。
records.back_translation: Cardiac ultrasound shows moderate dilatation of the coronary arteries, possibly with coronary aneurysm.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 56-year-old female on 20th day post-left mastectomy presents to the emergency department complaining of shortness of breath and malaise.
records.translation: 一名56歲女性於左側乳房切除術後第20天至急診就醫，主訴呼吸短促及全身倦怠。
records.back_translation: A 56-year-old woman came to the emergency department on day 20 after left mastectomy, complaining of shortness of breath and generalised malaise.

records.source: The patient says that she has remained in bed for the last two weeks.
records.translation: 患者表示過去兩週一直臥床。
records.back_translation: The patient says she has been bedridden for the past two weeks.

records.source: The physical examination reveals tenderness on the left upper thoracic wall and right calf.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現左上胸壁及右側小腿壓痛。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds tenderness of the left upper chest wall and right calf.

records.source: The surgical incision shows no bleeding or signs of infection.
records.translation: 手術傷口無出血或感染跡象。
records.back_translation: Surgical wound without bleeding or signs of infection.

records.source: Pulmonary auscultation is significant for bilateral decreased breath sounds, especially at the right base.
records.translation: 肺部聽診顯示兩側呼吸音減弱，以右下肺底最明顯。
records.back_translation: Lung auscultation shows bilateral reduced breath sounds, most marked at the right lower lung base.

records.source: Laboratory tests reveal an elevated D-dimer.
records.translation: 檢驗顯示D-dimer上升。
records.back_translation: Lab tests show raised D-dimer.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: 64-year-old obese female with diagnosis of diabetes mellitus and persistently elevated HbA1c.
records.translation: 64歲肥胖女性，診斷為糖尿病，HbA1c持續偏高。
records.back_translation: 64-year-old obese woman, diagnosed with diabetes, HbA1c persistently high.

records.source: She is reluctant to see a nutritionist and is not compliant with her diabetes medication or exercise.
records.translation: 她不願意去看營養師，且未遵從糖尿病藥物治療及運動建議。
records.back_translation: She is unwilling to see a dietitian, and does not follow diabetes drug treatment and exercise advice.

records.source: She complains of a painful skin lesion on the left lower leg.
records.translation: 她主訴左小腿有一處疼痛的皮膚病灶。
records.back_translation: She complains of a painful skin lesion on the left calf.

records.source: She has tried using topical lotions and creams but the lesion has increased in size and is now oozing.
records.translation: 她曾嘗試使用外用乳液及藥膏，但病灶仍逐漸擴大，目前已有滲液。
records.back_translation: She tried topical lotions and ointments, but the lesion has kept enlarging and now has exudate.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 26-year-old obese woman with a history of bipolar disorder complains that her recent struggles with her weight and eating have caused her to feel depressed.
records.translation: 一名26歲肥胖女性，有雙極性疾患病史，主訴近來在體重及飲食方面的困擾讓她感到憂鬱。
records.back_translation: A 26-year-old obese woman with a history of bipolar disorder complains that recent troubles with weight and eating make her feel depressed.

records.source: She states that she has recently had difficulty sleeping and feels excessively anxious and agitated.
records.translation: 她表示最近有睡眠困難，並感到過度焦慮及激躁。
records.back_translation: She says she recently has difficulty sleeping and feels excessively anxious and agitated.

records.source: She also states that she has had thoughts of suicide.
records.translation: 她也表示曾有自殺的念頭。
records.back_translation: She also says she has had thoughts of suicide.

records.source: She often finds herself fidgety and unable to sit still for extended periods of time.
records.translation: 她常覺得坐立不安，無法長時間靜坐。
records.back_translation: She often feels restless and cannot sit still for long.

records.source: Her family tells her that she is increasingly irritable.
records.translation: 家人告訴她，她變得越來越易怒。
records.back_translation: Her family tells her she is becoming more and more irritable.

records.source: Her current medications include lithium carbonate and zolpidem.
records.translation: 目前使用的藥物包括lithium carbonate及zolpidem。
records.back_translation: Current medications include lithium carbonate and zolpidem.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 62-year-old man sees a neurologist for progressive memory loss and jerking movements of the lower extremities.
records.translation: 一名62歲男性因進行性記憶喪失及下肢抽動性動作至神經科就診。
records.back_translation: A 62-year-old man came to neurology for progressive memory loss and jerking movements of the lower limbs.

records.source: Neurologic examination confirms severe cognitive deficits and memory dysfunction.
records.translation: 神經學檢查證實有嚴重認知缺損及記憶功能障礙。
records.back_translation: Neurological examination confirms severe cognitive deficit and memory dysfunction.

records.source: An electroencephalogram shows generalized periodic sharp waves.
records.translation: 腦波檢查顯示全面性週期性尖波。
records.back_translation: EEG shows generalised periodic sharp waves.

records.source: Neuroimaging studies show moderately advanced cerebral atrophy.
records.translation: 神經影像檢查顯示中度進展的大腦萎縮。
records.back_translation: Neuroimaging shows moderately advanced cerebral atrophy.

records.source: A cortical biopsy shows diffuse vacuolar changes of the gray matter with reactive astrocytosis but no inflammatory infiltration.
records.translation: 大腦皮質切片顯示灰質瀰漫性空泡變化，伴隨反應性星狀細胞增生，但無發炎細胞浸潤。
records.back_translation: Cerebral cortex biopsy shows diffuse vacuolar change of grey matter, with reactive astrocytosis, but no inflammatory cell infiltration.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 43-year-old woman visits her dermatologist for lesions on her neck.
records.translation: 一名43歲女性因頸部病灶至皮膚科就診。
records.back_translation: A 43-year-old woman came to dermatology for lesions on the neck.

records.source: On examination, multiple lesions are seen.
records.translation: 檢查時可見多處病灶。
records.back_translation: On examination multiple lesions are seen.

records.source: Each lesion is small soft, and pedunculated.
records.translation: 每個病灶皆小而柔軟，且呈有蒂狀。
records.back_translation: Each lesion is small and soft, and pedunculated.

records.source: The largest lesion is about 4 mm in diameter.
records.translation: 最大的病灶直徑約4 mm。
records.back_translation: The largest lesion is about 4 mm in diameter.

records.source: The color of different lesions varies from flesh colored to slightly hyperpigmented.
records.translation: 各病灶顏色不一，從膚色至輕度色素沉著皆有。
records.back_translation: The lesions vary in colour, from skin-coloured to mildly pigmented.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A physician is called to see a 67-year-old woman who underwent cardiac catheterization via the right femoral artery earlier in the morning.
records.translation: 醫師被會診一名67歲女性，她於當天上午經右側股動脈接受心導管檢查。
records.back_translation: A physician is consulted for a 67-year-old woman who had cardiac catheterisation via the right femoral artery that morning.

records.source: She is now complaining of a cool right foot.
records.translation: 她目前主訴右腳發冷。
records.back_translation: She now complains that her right foot is cold.

records.source: Upon examination she has a pulsatile mass in her right groin with loss of distal pulses, and auscultation reveals a bruit over the point at which the right femoral artery was entered.
records.translation: 檢查發現右側鼠蹊部有一搏動性腫塊，遠端脈搏消失，聽診於右側股動脈穿刺處可聞血管雜音。
records.back_translation: Examination finds a pulsatile mass in the right groin, distal pulses absent; on auscultation a vascular bruit is heard at the right femoral artery puncture site.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 40-year-old woman with no past medical history presents to the ER with excruciating pain in her right arm that had started 1 hour prior to her admission.
records.translation: 一名40歲女性，無過去病史，因右上肢劇烈疼痛至急診就醫，疼痛於入院前1小時開始。
records.back_translation: A 40-year-old woman with no past history came to the emergency department for severe pain of the right upper limb; the pain began 1 hour before admission.

records.source: She denies trauma.
records.translation: 患者否認有外傷。
records.back_translation: The patient denies trauma.

records.source: On examination she is pale and in moderate discomfort, as well as tachypneic and tachycardic.
records.translation: 檢查時患者臉色蒼白、中度不適，並有呼吸急促及心搏過速。
records.back_translation: On examination the patient is pale, moderately uncomfortable, with tachypnoea and tachycardia.

records.source: Her body temperature is normal and her blood pressure is 80/60.
records.translation: 體溫正常，血壓為80/60。
records.back_translation: Temperature normal, blood pressure 80/60.

records.source: Her right arm has no discoloration or movement limitation.
records.translation: 右上肢無變色，活動亦不受限。
records.back_translation: Right upper limb without discolouration, and movement is not limited.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 25-year-old woman presents to the clinic complaining of prolonged fatigue.
records.translation: 一名25歲女性至門診就醫，主訴長期疲倦。
records.back_translation: A 25-year-old woman came to the clinic complaining of long-term fatigue.

records.source: She denies difficulty sleeping and sleeps an average of 8 hours a night.
records.translation: 她否認有睡眠困難，平均每晚睡8小時。
records.back_translation: She denies difficulty sleeping and sleeps 8 hours a night on average.

records.source: She also notes hair loss, a change in her voice and weight gain during the previous 6 months.
records.translation: 她也提到過去6個月有掉髮、聲音改變及體重增加。
records.back_translation: She also mentions hair loss, voice change and weight gain over the past 6 months.

records.source: She complains of cold intolerance.
records.translation: 她主訴怕冷。
records.back_translation: She complains of feeling cold easily.

records.source: On examination she has a prominent, soft, uniform anterior cervical mass at the midline.
records.translation: 檢查發現頸部前方正中有一明顯、柔軟且均勻的腫塊。
records.back_translation: Examination finds a prominent, soft and uniform mass at the anterior midline of the neck.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 30-year-old generally healthy woman presents with shortness of breath that had started 2 hours before admission.
records.translation: 一名30歲、平時健康的女性，因入院前2小時開始的呼吸短促就醫。
records.back_translation: A 30-year-old, usually healthy woman came for shortness of breath that began 2 hours before admission.

records.source: She has had no health problems in the past besides 2 natural abortions.
records.translation: 除曾有2次自然流產外，過去無其他健康問題。
records.back_translation: Apart from 2 spontaneous abortions, no other health problems in the past.

records.source: She had given birth to a healthy child 3 weeks before.
records.translation: 她於3週前產下一名健康的嬰兒。
records.back_translation: She gave birth to a healthy baby 3 weeks ago.

records.source: On examination, she is apprehensive, tachypneic and tachycardic, her blood pressure is 110/70 and her oxygen saturation 92%.
records.translation: 檢查時患者神情焦慮，有呼吸急促及心搏過速，血壓110/70，血氧飽和度92%。
records.back_translation: On examination the patient looks anxious, with tachypnoea and tachycardia, blood pressure 110/70, oxygen saturation 92%.

records.source: Otherwise, physical examination is unremarkable.
records.translation: 其餘理學檢查無明顯異常。
records.back_translation: The rest of the physical examination without notable abnormality.

records.source: Her chest x-ray and CBC are normal.
records.translation: 胸部X光及全血球計數（CBC）正常。
records.back_translation: Chest X-ray and complete blood count (CBC) normal.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: An 85-year-old man is brought to the ER because of gradual decrease in his level of consciousness.
records.translation: 一名85歲男性因意識程度逐漸下降被送至急診。
records.back_translation: An 85-year-old man was sent to the emergency department because his level of consciousness gradually fell.

records.source: In the last 3 days he stopped walking and eating by himself.
records.translation: 過去3天他已無法自行行走及進食。
records.back_translation: In the past 3 days he has become unable to walk and eat by himself.

records.source: He has had no fever, cough, rash or diarrhea.
records.translation: 無發燒、咳嗽、皮疹或腹瀉。
records.back_translation: No fever, cough, rash or diarrhoea.

records.source: His daughter recalls that he had been involved in a car accident 3 weeks prior to his admission and had a normal head CT at that time.
records.translation: 他的女兒回憶，他在入院前3週曾發生車禍，當時頭部電腦斷層檢查正常。
records.back_translation: His daughter recalls that he had a car accident 3 weeks before admission, and head CT at that time was normal.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 36-year-old woman presents to the emergency department with 12 weeks of amenorrhea, vaginal spotting that has increased since yesterday, lower abdominal tenderness, nausea and vomiting.
records.translation: 一名36歲女性至急診就醫，表現為停經12週、陰道點狀出血自昨天起增加、下腹壓痛、噁心及嘔吐。
records.back_translation: A 36-year-old woman came to the emergency department presenting with amenorrhoea for 12 weeks, vaginal spotting increased since yesterday, lower abdominal tenderness, nausea and vomiting.

records.source: The physical exam reveals overall tender abdomen, 18-week sized uterus, and cervical dilation of 2 cm.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現全腹壓痛、子宮大小約如懷孕18週，子宮頸擴張2 cm。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds whole-abdomen tenderness, uterus about the size of 18 weeks of pregnancy, cervix dilated 2 cm.

records.source: The complete blood count and biochemical profile are normal.
records.translation: 全血球計數及生化檢驗皆正常。
records.back_translation: Complete blood count and biochemistry are both normal.

records.source: Point of care pregnancy test with cut-off sensitivity of 25 mIU/ml Beta-HCG is negative.
records.translation: 床邊驗孕試驗（Beta-HCG敏感度閾值25 mIU/ml）結果為陰性。
records.back_translation: Bedside pregnancy test (beta-HCG sensitivity threshold 25 mIU/ml) result negative.

records.source: The ultrasound reports enlarged uterus (12 cm x 9 cm x 7 cms) with multiple cystic areas in the interior.
records.translation: 超音波報告顯示子宮增大（12 cm x 9 cm x 7 cms），內部有多處囊狀區域。
records.back_translation: Ultrasound report shows uterine enlargement (12 cm x 9 cm x 7 cms), with multiple cystic areas inside.

records.source: The differential diagnosis includes vesicular mole vs fibroid degeneration.
records.translation: 鑑別診斷包括水泡狀胎塊與子宮肌瘤退化。
records.back_translation: Differential diagnosis includes hydatidiform mole vs uterine fibroid degeneration.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 28-year-old female with neck and shoulder pain and left hand and arm paresthesias three weeks after returning from a trip to California where she attended a stray animal recovery campaign.
records.translation: 一名28歲女性，在前往加州旅行（期間參加流浪動物救援活動）返回三週後，出現頸部及肩膀疼痛，以及左手和左上肢感覺異常。
records.back_translation: A 28-year-old woman, three weeks after returning from a trip to California (during which she joined a stray-animal rescue campaign), develops neck and shoulder pain and paraesthesia of the left hand and left upper limb.

records.source: Her physical exam was unremarkable except for slight tremors and almost imperceptible spasticity.
records.translation: 她的理學檢查除了輕微顫抖及幾乎難以察覺的痙攣外，其餘並無異常。
records.back_translation: Her physical examination, apart from slight trembling and almost imperceptible convulsion/spasm, is otherwise without abnormality.
records.what_differs: spasticity becomes 痙攣 (convulsion, spasm); spasticity is 痙直 or 痙縮
records.proposed_correction: 她的理學檢查除了輕微顫抖及幾乎難以察覺的痙直外，其餘並無異常。

records.source: She was prescribed NSAIDS and a topical muscle relaxant.
records.translation: 醫師開立NSAIDs及外用肌肉鬆弛劑。
records.back_translation: The physician prescribed NSAIDs and a topical muscle relaxant.

records.source: She was brought in to the ER three days later with spastic arm movements, sweating, increasing agitation and anxiety, malaise, difficultly swallowing and marked hydrophobia, and was immediately hospitalized.
records.translation: 三天後她因手臂痙攣性動作、出汗、激躁及焦慮加劇、全身倦怠、吞嚥困難及明顯恐水症狀被送至急診，並立即住院。
records.back_translation: Three days later she was sent to the emergency department for spastic arm movements, sweating, increasing agitation and anxiety, generalised malaise, difficulty swallowing and marked hydrophobia, and was admitted immediately.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 48-year-old white male with history of common variable immunodeficiency (CVID) with acute abdominal pain, fever, dehydration, HR of 132 bpm, BP 80/40.
records.translation: 一名48歲白人男性，有常見變異型免疫缺乏症（CVID）病史，表現為急性腹痛、發燒、脫水，心跳132 bpm，血壓80/40。
records.back_translation: A 48-year-old white man with a history of common variable immunodeficiency (CVID), presenting with acute abdominal pain, fever, dehydration, heart rate 132 bpm, blood pressure 80/40.

records.source: The physical examination is remarkable for tenderness and positive Murphy sign.
records.translation: 理學檢查顯示有壓痛及Murphy徵象陽性。
records.back_translation: Physical examination shows tenderness and positive Murphy sign.

records.source: Abdominal ultrasound shows hepatomegaly and abundant free intraperitoneal fluid.
records.translation: 腹部超音波顯示肝臟腫大及大量腹腔內游離液體。
records.back_translation: Abdominal ultrasound shows liver enlargement and a large amount of free intraperitoneal fluid.

records.source: Exploratory laparotomy reveals a ruptured liver abscess, which is then surgically drained.
records.translation: 剖腹探查發現肝膿瘍破裂，隨即進行手術引流。
records.back_translation: Exploratory laparotomy finds a ruptured liver abscess; surgical drainage then performed.

records.source: After surgery, the patient is taken to the ICU.
records.translation: 術後患者轉入加護病房。
records.back_translation: After surgery the patient was transferred to intensive care.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 6-month-old male infant has a urine output of less than 0.2 mL/kg/hr shortly after undergoing major surgery.
records.translation: 一名6個月大男嬰於接受重大手術後不久，尿量少於0.2 mL/kg/hr。
records.back_translation: A 6-month-old male infant, shortly after major surgery, has urine output less than 0.2 mL/kg/hr.

records.source: On examination, he has generalized edema.
records.translation: 檢查發現全身性水腫。
records.back_translation: Examination finds generalised oedema.

records.source: His blood pressure is 115/80 mm Hg, his pulse is 141/min, and his respirations are 18/min.
records.translation: 血壓115/80 mm Hg，脈搏141/min，呼吸18/min。
records.back_translation: Blood pressure 115/80 mm Hg, pulse 141/min, respiration 18/min.

records.source: His blood urea nitrogen is 33 mg/dL, and his serum creatinine is 1.3 mg/dL.
records.translation: 血中尿素氮33 mg/dL，血清肌酸酐1.3 mg/dL。
records.back_translation: Blood urea nitrogen 33 mg/dL, serum creatinine 1.3 mg/dL.

records.source: Initial urinalysis shows specific gravity of 1.017.
records.translation: 初次尿液分析顯示比重1.017。
records.back_translation: First urinalysis shows specific gravity 1.017.

records.source: Microscopic examination of the urine sample reveals 1 WBC per high-power field (HPF), 18 RBCs per HPF, and 5 granular casts per HPF.
records.translation: 尿液顯微鏡檢查顯示每高倍視野（HPF）1個白血球、每HPF 18個紅血球，以及每HPF 5個顆粒圓柱體。
records.back_translation: Urine microscopy shows 1 white cell per high-power field (HPF), 18 red cells per HPF, and 5 granular casts per HPF.

records.source: His fractional excretion of sodium is 3.3%.
records.translation: 鈉排泄分率為3.3%。
records.back_translation: Fractional excretion of sodium is 3.3%.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 52-year-old African American man with a history of heavy smoking and drinking, describes progressive dysphagia that began several months ago.
records.translation: 一名52歲非裔美籍男性，有重度抽菸及飲酒史，描述數個月前開始出現進行性吞嚥困難。
records.back_translation: A 52-year-old African-American man with a history of heavy smoking and drinking describes progressive difficulty swallowing that began several months ago.

records.source: He first noticed difficulty swallowing meat.
records.translation: 他最初注意到吞嚥肉類有困難。
records.back_translation: He first noticed difficulty swallowing meat.

records.source: His trouble swallowing then progressed to include other solid foods, soft foods, and then liquids.
records.translation: 之後吞嚥困難逐漸進展至其他固體食物、軟質食物，最後連液體也難以吞嚥。
records.back_translation: Then the swallowing difficulty progressed to other solid food, soft food, and finally even liquids were hard to swallow.

records.source: He is able to locate the point where food is obstructed at the lower end of his sternum.
records.translation: 他能指出食物卡住的位置在胸骨下端。
records.back_translation: He can point out that food gets stuck at the lower end of the sternum.

records.source: He has lost a total of 25 pounds.
records.translation: 他的體重共減輕了25磅。
records.back_translation: His weight has fallen by 25 pounds in total.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 32-year-old woman is admitted to the ER following a car accident.
records.translation: 一名32歲女性因車禍被送入急診。
records.back_translation: A 32-year-old woman was brought into the emergency department because of a car accident.

records.source: She has sustained multiple injuries including upper and lower extremity fractures.
records.translation: 她受到多處外傷，包括上肢及下肢骨折。
records.back_translation: She has multiple injuries, including upper and lower limb fractures.

records.source: She is fully awake and alert, and she reports that she was not wearing a seat belt.
records.translation: 她意識完全清醒、警覺，並表示當時未繫安全帶。
records.back_translation: She is fully conscious and alert, and says she was not wearing a seat belt at the time.

records.source: Her blood pressure is 134/74 mm Hg, and her pulse is 87/min.
records.translation: 血壓134/74 mm Hg，脈搏87/min。
records.back_translation: Blood pressure 134/74 mm Hg, pulse 87/min.

records.source: Physical examination reveals a tender abdomen with guarding and rebound in all four quadrants.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現腹部壓痛，四個象限皆有腹肌防禦及反彈痛。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds abdominal tenderness, with guarding and rebound pain in all four quadrants.

records.source: She has no bowel sounds.
records.translation: 腸音消失。
records.back_translation: Bowel sounds absent.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 21-year-old female is evaluated for progressive arthralgias and malaise.
records.translation: 一名21歲女性因進行性關節痛及全身倦怠接受評估。
records.back_translation: A 21-year-old woman is evaluated for progressive joint pain and generalised malaise.

records.source: On examination she is found to have alopecia, a rash mainly distributed on the bridge of her nose and her cheeks, a delicate non-palpable purpura on her calves, and swelling and tenderness of her wrists and ankles.
records.translation: 檢查發現有掉髮、主要分布於鼻樑及雙頰的皮疹、雙側小腿細緻且不可觸及的紫斑，以及雙側手腕及腳踝腫脹與壓痛。
records.back_translation: Examination finds hair loss, a rash mainly on the bridge of the nose and both cheeks, delicate non-palpable purpura on both calves, and swelling and tenderness of both wrists and ankles.

records.source: Her lab shows normocytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, a 4/4 positive ANA and anti-dsDNA.
records.translation: 檢驗顯示正球性貧血、血小板低下、ANA 4/4陽性及anti-dsDNA陽性。
records.back_translation: Labs show normocytic anaemia, low platelets, ANA 4/4 positive and anti-dsDNA positive.

records.source: Her urine is positive for protein and RBC casts.
records.translation: 尿液檢查蛋白質及紅血球圓柱體呈陽性。
records.back_translation: Urine test positive for protein and red cell casts.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 15-year-old girl presents to the ER with abdominal pain.
records.translation: 一名15歲女孩因腹痛至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: A 15-year-old girl came to the emergency department for abdominal pain.

records.source: The pain appeared gradually and was periumbilical at first, localizing to the right lower quadrant over hours.
records.translation: 疼痛為漸進性出現，起初位於肚臍周圍，數小時內轉移並局限於右下腹。
records.back_translation: The pain appeared gradually, at first around the umbilicus, and within several hours moved to and localised in the right lower abdomen.

records.source: She has had no appetite since yesterday but denies diarrhea.
records.translation: 她從昨天起就沒有食慾，但否認腹瀉。
records.back_translation: She has had no appetite since yesterday, but denies diarrhoea.

records.source: She has had no sexual partners and her menses are regular.
records.translation: 她沒有性伴侶，月經規則。
records.back_translation: She has no sexual partners; menstruation regular.

records.source: On examination, she has localized rebound tenderness over the right lower quadrant.
records.translation: 檢查發現右下腹有局部反彈痛。
records.back_translation: Examination finds local rebound pain in the right lower abdomen.

records.source: On an abdominal ultrasound, a markedly edematous appendix is seen.
records.translation: 腹部超音波可見明顯水腫的闌尾。
records.back_translation: Abdominal ultrasound shows a markedly oedematous appendix.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 63-year-old man presents with cough and shortness of breath.
records.translation: 一名63歲男性因咳嗽及呼吸短促就醫。
records.back_translation: A 63-year-old man came for cough and shortness of breath.

records.source: His past medical history is notable for heavy smoking, spinal stenosis, diabetes, hypothyroidism and mild psoriasis.
records.translation: 過去病史值得注意的有重度抽菸、脊椎管狹窄、糖尿病、甲狀腺功能低下及輕度乾癬。
records.back_translation: Notable past history: heavy smoking, spinal canal stenosis, diabetes, hypothyroidism and mild psoriasis.

records.source: He also has a family history of early onset dementia.
records.translation: 他也有早發性失智症的家族史。
records.back_translation: He also has a family history of early-onset dementia.

records.source: His symptoms began about a week prior to his admission, with productive cough, purulent sputum and difficulty breathing, requiring him to use his home oxygen for the past 24 hours.
records.translation: 症狀約於入院前一週開始，有濕咳、膿痰及呼吸困難，過去24小時需使用居家氧氣。
records.back_translation: Symptoms began about one week before admission, with wet cough, purulent sputum and dyspnoea; in the past 24 hours he has needed home oxygen.

records.source: He denies fever.
records.translation: 他否認發燒。
records.back_translation: He denies fever.

records.source: On examination he is cyanotic, tachypneic, with a barrel shaped chest and diffuse rales over his lungs.
records.translation: 檢查時患者發紺、呼吸急促，呈桶狀胸，雙肺可聞瀰漫性囉音。
records.back_translation: On examination the patient is cyanotic, tachypnoeic, barrel-chested, with diffuse rales heard over both lungs.

records.source: A chest x-ray is notable for hyperinflation with no consolidation.
records.translation: 胸部X光顯示肺部過度充氣，無實質化病灶。
records.back_translation: Chest X-ray shows lung hyperinflation, without consolidation.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 33-year-old male athlete presented to the ER with acute abdominal pain.
records.translation: 一名33歲男性運動員因急性腹痛至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: A 33-year-old male athlete came to the emergency department for acute abdominal pain.

records.source: Family member says the patient fell off his bike a week earlier and suffered blunt trauma to the left hemi-abdomen, and he has had mild abdominal pain since that day.
records.translation: 家屬表示患者一週前從腳踏車上摔下，左半側腹部受到鈍挫傷，自當天起即有輕微腹痛。
records.back_translation: Family say the patient fell off a bicycle a week ago and had blunt trauma to the left half of the abdomen; since that day he has had mild abdominal pain.

records.source: The patient's history is negative for smoking, drugs, and alcohol.
records.translation: 患者無抽菸、藥物使用及飲酒史。
records.back_translation: The patient has no smoking, drug-use or drinking history.

records.source: BP: 60/30 mmHg, HR: 140/min.
records.translation: 血壓：60/30 mmHg，心跳：140/min。
records.back_translation: Blood pressure: 60/30 mmHg, heart rate: 140/min.

records.source: The patient is pale, the physical examination of the abdomen revealed muscle contraction and resistance.
records.translation: 患者臉色蒼白，腹部理學檢查發現肌肉收縮及抵抗。
records.back_translation: The patient is pale; abdominal physical examination finds muscle contraction and resistance.

records.source: Emergency ultrasound and CT scan of the abdomen reveal extended intraperitoneal hemorrhage due to spleen rupture.
records.translation: 緊急腹部超音波及電腦斷層顯示脾臟破裂導致大範圍腹腔內出血。
records.back_translation: Emergency abdominal ultrasound and CT show splenic rupture causing extensive intraperitoneal haemorrhage.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: An 8-year-old boy fell from his bike striking his left temple on the pavement.
records.translation: 一名8歲男童從腳踏車上摔下，左側太陽穴撞擊路面。
records.back_translation: An 8-year-old boy fell off a bicycle, and his left temple hit the road surface.

records.source: There was no immediate loss of consciousness, and a brief examination at the scene noted his pupils were symmetrical, reactive to the light, and he was moving all four limbs.
records.translation: 當下並無立即意識喪失，現場簡短檢查發現瞳孔對稱、對光有反應，四肢皆能活動。
records.back_translation: At the time there was no immediate loss of consciousness; a brief examination at the scene found the pupils symmetrical and reactive to light, and all four limbs able to move.

records.source: Half an hour after the fall the child became drowsy, pale, and vomited.
records.translation: 摔倒半小時後，病童變得嗜睡、臉色蒼白並出現嘔吐。
records.back_translation: Half an hour after the fall, the child became drowsy, pale and vomited.

records.source: He was transferred to the emergency department.
records.translation: 病童被轉送至急診。
records.back_translation: The child was transferred to the emergency department.

records.source: Upon arrival the heart rate was 52/min, blood pressure of 155/98.
records.translation: 抵達時心跳52/min，血壓155/98。
records.back_translation: On arrival heart rate 52/min, blood pressure 155/98.

records.source: The Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) was 6/15, the pupils were asymmetrical and movement of the right upper and lower extremities was impaired.
records.translation: 格拉斯哥昏迷指數（GCS）為6/15，瞳孔不對稱，右側上下肢活動功能受損。
records.back_translation: Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) 6/15, pupils asymmetrical, movement of the right upper and lower limbs impaired.

records.source: The neurosurgical team advised deferring the CT scan in favor of initiating immediate treatment.
records.translation: 神經外科團隊建議暫緩電腦斷層檢查，優先立即開始治療。
records.back_translation: The neurosurgery team advised holding off the CT and starting treatment immediately as a priority.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A group of 14 humanitarian service workers is preparing a trip to the Amazon Rainforest region in Brazil.
records.translation: 一個由14名人道服務工作者組成的團體正準備前往巴西亞馬遜雨林地區。
records.back_translation: A group of 14 humanitarian service workers is preparing to go to the Amazon rainforest region in Brazil.

records.source: All the members of the group have traveled on multiple occasions and have up-to-date vaccine certificates.
records.translation: 團體所有成員皆曾多次出國旅行，且疫苗接種證明皆為最新。
records.back_translation: All members of the group have travelled abroad many times, and their vaccination certificates are all up to date.

records.source: Malaria Chemoprophylaxis is indicated but three of the women are in different stages of pregnancy.
records.translation: 有接受瘧疾預防性投藥的適應症，但其中三名女性處於不同的懷孕階段。
records.back_translation: There is an indication for malaria preventive medication, but three of the women are at different stages of pregnancy.

records.source: A 21-year-old college student undergoes colonoscopy due to family history of multiple polyps in his older siblings.
records.translation: 一名21歲大學生因兄姊有多發性息肉的家族史而接受大腸鏡檢查。
records.back_translation: A 21-year-old university student has a colonoscopy because of a family history of multiple polyps in his older brother and sister.

records.source: His brother underwent total proctocolectomy at age 22, and his sister underwent a total proctocolectomy at age 28, after both were found to have hundreds of colonic adenomas on colonoscopy.
records.translation: 他的哥哥在22歲時接受全大腸直腸切除術，姊姊在28歲時接受全大腸直腸切除術，兩人皆是在大腸鏡檢查發現數百顆大腸腺瘤之後接受手術。
records.back_translation: His older brother had total proctocolectomy at 22, his older sister had total proctocolectomy at 28; both had surgery after colonoscopy found hundreds of colonic adenomas.

records.source: Both siblings are currently well without any findings of neoplasms.
records.translation: 兩位手足目前狀況良好，無任何腫瘤發現。
records.back_translation: Both siblings are currently well, with no tumour found.

records.source: The patient undergoes sigmoidoscopy and is found to have dozens of small colonic polyps within rectosigmoid.
records.translation: 患者接受乙狀結腸鏡檢查，發現直腸乙狀結腸內有數十顆小型大腸息肉。
records.back_translation: The patient has a sigmoidoscopy, which finds dozens of small colonic polyps in the rectosigmoid.

records.source: Several of these are biopsied and are all benign adenomas.
records.translation: 其中數顆進行切片，結果皆為良性腺瘤。
records.back_translation: Several of them were biopsied; all were benign adenomas.

records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 51-year-old woman is seen in clinic for advice on osteoporosis.
records.translation: 一名51歲女性至門診諮詢骨質疏鬆症相關建議。
records.back_translation: A 51-year-old woman came to the clinic for advice about osteoporosis.

records.source: She has a past medical history of significant hypertension and diet-controlled diabetes mellitus.
records.translation: 她的過去病史包括明顯的高血壓及以飲食控制的糖尿病。
records.back_translation: Her past history includes marked hypertension and diet-controlled diabetes.

records.source: She currently smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day.
records.translation: 她目前每天抽1包菸。
records.back_translation: She currently smokes 1 pack a day.

records.source: She was documented by previous LH and FSH levels to be in menopause within the last year.
records.translation: 先前LH及FSH檢驗結果證實她於過去一年內進入停經。
records.back_translation: Earlier LH and FSH results confirmed that she entered menopause within the past year.

records.source: She is concerned about breaking her hip as she gets older and is seeking advice on osteoporosis prevention.
records.translation: 她擔心年紀漸長後會髖部骨折，希望獲得預防骨質疏鬆症的建議。
records.back_translation: She worries about hip fracture as she gets older and wants advice on preventing osteoporosis.

records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 72-year-old man complains of increasing calf pain when walking uphill.
records.translation: 一名72歲男性主訴走上坡時小腿疼痛逐漸加劇。
records.back_translation: A 72-year-old man complains that calf pain gets worse when walking uphill.

records.source: The symptoms have gradually increased over the past 3 months.
records.translation: 症狀在過去3個月內逐漸加重。
records.back_translation: Symptoms have gradually worsened over the past 3 months.

records.source: The patient had an uncomplicated myocardial infarction 2 years earlier and a transient ischemic attack 6 months ago.
records.translation: 患者2年前曾發生無併發症的心肌梗塞，6個月前曾發生暫時性腦缺血發作。
records.back_translation: The patient had an uncomplicated myocardial infarction 2 years ago and a transient ischaemic attack 6 months ago.

records.source: Over the past month, his blood pressure has worsened despite previous control with diltiazem, hydrochlorothiazide, and propranolol.
records.translation: 過去一個月，他的血壓惡化，先前以diltiazem、hydrochlorothiazide及propranolol控制良好。
records.back_translation: Over the past month his blood pressure has worsened; it was previously well controlled with diltiazem, hydrochlorothiazide and propranolol.
records.what_differs: adds 良好 ('well' controlled); the source says only 'previous control'
records.proposed_correction: 過去一個月，儘管先前以diltiazem、hydrochlorothiazide及propranolol控制，他的血壓仍惡化。

records.source: His is currently taking isosorbide dinitrate, hydrochlorothiazide, and aspirin.
records.translation: 他目前服用isosorbide dinitrate、hydrochlorothiazide及aspirin。
records.back_translation: He currently takes isosorbide dinitrate, hydrochlorothiazide and aspirin.

records.source: On physical examination, his blood pressure is 151/91 mm Hg, and his pulse is 67/min.
records.translation: 理學檢查時血壓151/91 mm Hg，脈搏67/min。
records.back_translation: On physical examination blood pressure 151/91 mm Hg, pulse 67/min.

records.source: There is a right carotid bruit.
records.translation: 右側頸動脈可聞血管雜音。
records.back_translation: A vascular bruit can be heard over the right carotid artery.

records.source: His lower extremities are slightly cool to the touch and have diminished pulses at the dorsalis pedis.
records.translation: 雙下肢觸摸時稍冷，足背動脈脈搏減弱。
records.back_translation: Both lower limbs slightly cold to touch; dorsalis pedis pulses reduced.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 44 yo male is brought to the emergency room after multiple bouts of vomiting that has a "coffee ground" appearance.
records.translation: 一名44歲男性在多次嘔吐「咖啡渣樣」物後被送至急診。
records.back_translation: A 44-year-old man was sent to the emergency department after vomiting "coffee-ground-like" material several times.

records.source: His heart rate is 135 bpm and blood pressure is 70/40 mmHg.
records.translation: 心跳135 bpm，血壓70/40 mmHg。
records.back_translation: Heart rate 135 bpm, blood pressure 70/40 mmHg.

records.source: Physical exam findings include decreased mental status and cool extremities.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現意識狀態下降及四肢冰冷。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds reduced mental status and cold extremities.

records.source: He receives a rapid infusion of crystalloid solution followed by packed red blood cell transfusion and is admitted to the ICU for further care.
records.translation: 他接受晶體溶液快速輸注，隨後輸注濃縮紅血球，並轉入加護病房進一步照護。
records.back_translation: He received a rapid infusion of crystalloid solution, then packed red cells, and was transferred to intensive care for further care.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 62 yo male presents with four days of non-productive cough and one day of fever.
records.translation: 一名62歲男性因乾咳四天及發燒一天就醫。
records.back_translation: A 62-year-old man came for dry cough for four days and fever for one day.

records.source: He is on immunosuppressive medications, including prednisone.
records.translation: 他正在使用免疫抑制藥物，包括prednisone。
records.back_translation: He is using immunosuppressive drugs, including prednisone.

records.source: He is admitted to the hospital, and his work-up includes bronchoscopy with bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL).
records.translation: 他住院接受檢查，其中包括支氣管鏡及支氣管肺泡灌洗術（BAL）。
records.back_translation: He was admitted for work-up, including bronchoscopy and bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL).

records.source: BAL fluid examination reveals owl's eye inclusion bodies in the nuclei of infection cells.
records.translation: BAL液體檢查發現受感染細胞的細胞核內有鷹眼狀包涵體。
records.back_translation: BAL fluid examination finds hawk's-eye-shaped inclusion bodies in the nuclei of infected cells.
records.what_differs: owl's eye becomes 鷹眼 (hawk's eye); 貓頭鷹眼 is owl's eye. The shorter form may be in use in Taiwanese teaching; a reader decides
records.proposed_correction: BAL液體檢查發現受感染細胞的細胞核內有貓頭鷹眼狀包涵體。

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 65 yo male with no significant history of cardiovascular disease presents to the emergency room with acute onset of shortness of breath, tachypnea, and left-sided chest pain that worsens with inspiration.
records.translation: 一名65歲男性，無明顯心血管疾病病史，因急性發作的呼吸短促、呼吸急促及吸氣時加劇的左側胸痛至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: A 65-year-old man without notable cardiovascular history came to the emergency department for acute-onset shortness of breath, tachypnoea and left chest pain worse on inspiration.

records.source: Of note, he underwent a right total hip replacement two weeks prior to presentation and  was unable to begin physical therapy and rehabilitation for several days following the surgery due to poor pain management.
records.translation: 值得注意的是，他於就診前兩週接受右側全髖關節置換術，術後因疼痛控制不佳，有數天無法開始物理治療及復健。
records.back_translation: Of note, he had a right total hip replacement two weeks before the visit; after surgery, because of poor pain control, he could not start physical therapy and rehabilitation for several days.

records.source: Relevant physical exam findings include a respiratory rate of 35 and right calf pain.
records.translation: 相關理學檢查發現包括呼吸速率35及右側小腿疼痛。
records.back_translation: Relevant physical findings include respiratory rate 35 and right calf pain.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: An 82-year-old woman comes to the emergency department because of chest pain and shortness of breath after being awakened in the morning by stabbing substernal chest pain radiating to the left shoulder and jaw.
records.translation: 一名82歲女性早上被胸骨下刺痛痛醒，疼痛放射至左肩及下顎，因胸痛及呼吸短促至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: An 82-year-old woman was woken in the morning by stabbing substernal pain radiating to the left shoulder and lower jaw, and came to the emergency department for chest pain and shortness of breath.

records.source: The patient had hypertension, renal-artery stenosis with chronic renal insufficiency, hypercholesterolemia, osteoporosis and dementia.
records.translation: 患者有高血壓、腎動脈狹窄合併慢性腎功能不全、高膽固醇血症、骨質疏鬆症及失智症。
records.back_translation: The patient has hypertension, renal artery stenosis with chronic renal insufficiency, hypercholesterolaemia, osteoporosis and dementia.

records.source: Blood pressure was 199/108 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18 bpm, oxygen saturation 98% on ambient air.
records.translation: 血壓199/108 mm Hg，呼吸速率18 bpm，未使用氧氣下血氧飽和度98%。
records.back_translation: Blood pressure 199/108 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18 bpm, oxygen saturation 98% without oxygen.

records.source: The heart sounds were rapid and with no murmurs.
records.translation: 心音快速，無心雜音。
records.back_translation: Heart sounds rapid, no murmur.

records.source: CK-MB was 10.9 ng/ml, CK was 89 U/l, CK index was 12.2% and Troponin T was 0.40 ng/ml.
records.translation: CK-MB為10.9 ng/ml，CK為89 U/l，CK指數為12.2%，Troponin T為0.40 ng/ml。
records.back_translation: CK-MB 10.9 ng/ml, CK 89 U/l, CK index 12.2%, Troponin T 0.40 ng/ml.

records.source: An EKG showed sinus regular tachycardia of 119 bpm, with ST-segment elevations up to 3 mm in V1, V2, and V3.
records.translation: 心電圖顯示竇性規則心搏過速119 bpm，V1、V2及V3導程ST段上升達3 mm。
records.back_translation: ECG shows sinus regular tachycardia 119 bpm, ST elevation reaching 3 mm in leads V1, V2 and V3.

records.source: A chest radiograph showed low lung volumes and right basilar subsegmental atelectasis.
records.translation: 胸部X光顯示肺容積偏低及右下肺底次節段性肺塌陷。
records.back_translation: Chest X-ray shows low lung volume and subsegmental atelectasis at the right lower lung base.

records.source: Coronary angiography showed no stenosis or clinically significant disease.
records.translation: 冠狀動脈攝影顯示無狹窄或具臨床意義的病變。
records.back_translation: Coronary angiography shows no stenosis or clinically significant lesion.

records.source: Left ventriculography revealed akinesis of the anterior wall, hypokinesis of the apical and distal inferior walls, and compensatory hyperkinesis of the basal anterior and basal inferior walls.
records.translation: 左心室攝影顯示前壁無運動、心尖部及下壁遠端運動減弱，以及前壁基部與下壁基部代償性運動增強。
records.back_translation: Left ventriculography shows akinesis of the anterior wall, hypokinesis of the apex and distal inferior wall, and compensatory hyperkinesis of the basal anterior and basal inferior walls.

records.source: A transthoracic echocardiogram showed severe segmental left ventricular dysfunction involving the septum, anteroseptal territory, and apex.
records.translation: 經胸心臟超音波顯示嚴重節段性左心室功能不全，範圍涵蓋中隔、前中隔區域及心尖。
records.back_translation: Transthoracic echo shows severe segmental left ventricular dysfunction covering the septum, anteroseptal region and apex.

records.source: The overall left ventricular systolic function was mildly impaired and there was mild mitral regurgitation.
records.translation: 整體左心室收縮功能輕度受損，並有輕度二尖瓣逆流。
records.back_translation: Overall left ventricular systolic function mildly impaired, with mild mitral regurgitation.

records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 31-year-old woman with no previous medical problems comes to the emergency room with a history of 2 weeks of joint pain and fatigue.
records.translation: 一名31歲女性，過去無任何病史，因關節疼痛及疲倦2週至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: A 31-year-old woman with no past history came to the emergency department for joint pain and fatigue for 2 weeks.

records.source: Initially she had right ankle swelling and difficulty standing up and walking, all of which resolved after a few days.
records.translation: 起初她右側腳踝腫脹，站立及行走困難，這些症狀在數天後皆已緩解。
records.back_translation: At first she had right ankle swelling and difficulty standing and walking; these symptoms all resolved after several days.

records.source: For the past several days she has had pain, swelling and stiffness in her knees, hips and right elbow.
records.translation: 過去數天她的膝蓋、髖部及右側手肘出現疼痛、腫脹及僵硬。
records.back_translation: In the past several days her knees, hips and right elbow have developed pain, swelling and stiffness.

records.source: She also reports intermittent fevers ranging from 38.2 to 39.4 degrees Celsius and chest pain.
records.translation: 她也表示有間歇性發燒，體溫介於攝氏38.2至39.4度，並有胸痛。
records.back_translation: She also reports intermittent fever, temperature between 38.2 and 39.4 degrees Celsius, and chest pain.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 46-year-old woman presents  with a 9 month history of weight loss (20 lb), sweating, insomnia and diarrhea.
records.translation: 一名46歲女性就醫，有9個月的體重減輕（20 lb）、出汗、失眠及腹瀉病史。
records.back_translation: A 46-year-old woman came with a 9-month history of weight loss (20 lb), sweating, insomnia and diarrhoea.

records.source: She reports to have been eating more than normal and that her heart sometimes races for no reason.
records.translation: 她表示食量比平常多，且心跳有時會無故加速。
records.back_translation: She says she eats more than usual, and her heart sometimes speeds up for no reason.

records.source: On physical examination her hands are warm and sweaty, her pulse is irregular at 110bpm and there is hyperreflexia and mild exophthalmia.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現她雙手溫暖潮濕，脈搏不規則，速率110bpm，並有反射亢進及輕度眼球突出。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds her hands warm and moist, pulse irregular at 110 bpm, with hyperreflexia and mild exophthalmos.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 20 yo female college student with no significant past medical history presents with a chief complaint of fatigue.
records.translation: 一名20歲女大學生，無明顯過去病史，主訴為疲倦。
records.back_translation: A 20-year-old female university student with no notable past history; chief complaint fatigue.

records.source: She reports increased sleep and appetite over the past few months as well as difficulty concentrating on her schoolwork.
records.translation: 她表示過去幾個月睡眠及食慾增加，且難以專注於課業。
records.back_translation: She says that over the past few months sleep and appetite have increased, and it is hard to concentrate on schoolwork.

records.source: She no longer enjoys spending time with her friends and feels guilty for not spending more time with her family.
records.translation: 她不再喜歡和朋友相處，並因沒有多花時間陪伴家人而感到內疚。
records.back_translation: She no longer likes being with friends, and feels guilty for not spending more time with her family.

records.source: Her physical exam and laboratory tests, including hemoglobin, hematocrit and thyroid stimulating hormone, are within normal limits.
records.translation: 她的理學檢查及檢驗結果，包括血紅素、血球容積比及甲狀腺刺激素，皆在正常範圍內。
records.back_translation: Her physical examination and labs, including haemoglobin, haematocrit and thyroid-stimulating hormone, are all within normal range.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 10 yo boy with nighttime snoring, pauses in breathing, and restlessness with nighttime awakenings.
records.translation: 一名10歲男童有夜間打鼾、呼吸暫停，以及睡眠不安並於夜間醒來。

records.back_translation: No history of headache or night terrors.

records.source: The boy's teacher recently contacted his parents because she was concerned about his declining grades, lack of attention, and excessive sleepiness during class.
records.translation: 男童的老師最近聯絡他的父母，因為擔心他成績下滑、注意力不集中，以及上課時過度嗜睡。
records.back_translation: The boy's teacher recently contacted his parents, worried about his falling grades, poor attention and excessive sleepiness in class.

records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 10 year old child is brought to the emergency room complaining of myalgia, cough, and shortness of breath.
records.translation: 一名10歲兒童因肌肉痠痛、咳嗽及呼吸短促被帶至急診。
records.back_translation: A 10-year-old child was brought to the emergency department for muscle aches, cough and shortness of breath.

records.source: Two weeks ago the patient was seen by his pediatrician for low-grade fever, abdominal pain, and diarrhea, diagnosed with a viral illness, and prescribed OTC medications.
records.translation: 兩週前病童曾因低度發燒、腹痛及腹瀉至小兒科醫師處就診，被診斷為病毒感染，並開立成藥（OTC）。
records.back_translation: Two weeks ago the child saw a paediatrician for low-grade fever, abdominal pain and diarrhoea, was diagnosed with a viral infection, and was prescribed over-the-counter drugs (OTC).

records.source: Three weeks ago the family returned home after a stay with relatives on a farm that raises domestic pigs for consumption.
records.translation: 三週前全家人到飼養食用家豬的親戚農場住了一段時間後返家。
records.back_translation: Three weeks ago the whole family went to stay for a while on a relatives' farm raising domestic pigs for food, and then came home.
records.what_differs: 'three weeks ago' moves from the return home to the trip: 三週前 now governs going to the farm, so the exposure window reads as starting three weeks ago rather than ending then
records.proposed_correction: 全家人在飼養食用家豬的親戚農場住了一段時間，於三週前返家。

records.source: Vital signs: T: 39.5 C, BP: 90/60 HR: 120/min RR: 40/min.
records.translation: 生命徵象：體溫：39.5 C，血壓：90/60，心跳：120/min，呼吸速率：40/min。
records.back_translation: Vital signs: temperature 39.5 C, blood pressure 90/60, heart rate 120/min, respiratory rate 40/min.

records.source: Physical exam findings include cyanosis,  slight stiffness of the neck,  and  marked periorbital edema.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現包括發紺、頸部輕微僵硬，以及明顯的眼眶周圍水腫。
records.back_translation: Physical findings include cyanosis, slight neck stiffness, and marked periorbital oedema.

records.back_translation: Lab results include white cells 25,000, of which eosinophils 25%; urinalysis without notable abnormality.
