records.source: A 38 year old woman complains of severe premenstrual and menstrual pelvic pain, heavy, irregular periods and occasional spotting between periods.
records.translation: 一名38歲女性主訴經前及經期嚴重骨盆腔疼痛、經血量多且週期不規則，偶有經期間點狀出血。
records.back_translation: A 38-year-old woman complains of severe pelvic pain before and during periods, heavy and irregular periods, and occasional intermenstrual spotting.

records.source: Past medical history remarkable for  two years of infertility treatment and an ectopic pregnancy at age 26.
records.translation: 過去病史值得注意的有兩年的不孕症治療，以及26歲時曾有子宮外孕。
records.back_translation: Notable past history: two years of infertility treatment, and an ectopic pregnancy at age 26.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 56-year old Caucasian female complains of being markedly more sensitive to the cold than most people.
records.translation: 一名56歲白人女性主訴比大多數人明顯更怕冷。
records.back_translation: A 56-year-old white woman complains that she feels the cold markedly more than most people.

records.source: She also gets tired easily, has decreased appetite, and has recently tried home remedies for her constipation.
records.translation: 她也容易疲倦、食慾減退，最近曾嘗試用居家偏方處理便秘。
records.back_translation: She also tires easily, has reduced appetite, and recently tried home remedies for constipation.

records.source: Physical examination reveals hyporeflexia with delayed relaxation of knee and ankle reflexes, and very dry skin.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現反射減弱，膝反射及踝反射的放鬆期延遲，且皮膚非常乾燥。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds reduced reflexes, delayed relaxation phase of the knee and ankle reflexes, and very dry skin.

records.source: She moves and talks slowly.
records.translation: 她的動作及說話都很緩慢。
records.back_translation: Her movement and speech are both slow.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 44-year-old man was recently in an automobile accident where he sustained a skull fracture.
records.translation: 一名44歲男性最近發生車禍，造成顱骨骨折。
records.back_translation: A 44-year-old man recently had a car accident causing a skull fracture.

records.source: In the emergency room, he noted clear fluid dripping from his nose.
records.translation: 在急診時，他發現有清澈液體從鼻子滴出。
records.back_translation: In the emergency department he noticed clear fluid dripping from his nose.

records.source: The following day he started complaining of severe headache and fever.
records.translation: 隔天他開始主訴劇烈頭痛及發燒。
records.back_translation: The next day he began complaining of severe headache and fever.

records.source: Nuchal rigidity was found on physical examination.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現頸部僵硬。
records.back_translation: Physical examination found neck stiffness.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 5-year-old boy presents to the emergency department with complaints of progressively worsening dysphagia, drooling, fever and vocal changes.
records.translation: 一名5歲男童因吞嚥困難逐漸惡化、流口水、發燒及聲音改變至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: A 5-year-old boy came to the emergency department for progressively worsening difficulty swallowing, drooling, fever and voice change.

records.source: He is toxic-appearing, and leans forward while sitting on his mother's lap.
records.translation: 病童外觀呈中毒病容，坐在母親腿上時身體前傾。
records.back_translation: The child looks toxic, and leans forward while sitting on his mother's lap.

records.source: He is drooling and speaks with a muffled "hot potato" voice.
records.translation: 他持續流口水，說話聲音含糊，呈「熱馬鈴薯」嗓音。
records.back_translation: He keeps drooling; his voice is muffled, a "hot potato" voice.

records.source: The parents deny the possibility of foreign body ingestion or trauma, and they report that they are delaying some of his vaccines.
records.translation: 父母否認有誤食異物或外傷的可能，並表示他有部分疫苗延遲接種。
records.back_translation: The parents deny possible foreign body ingestion or trauma, and say that some of his vaccines are delayed.
records.what_differs: 'they are delaying some of his vaccines' (the parents' choice) becomes 'some of his vaccines are delayed'; who delays is lost
records.proposed_correction: 父母否認有誤食異物或外傷的可能，並表示他們延後了他部分疫苗的接種。

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 27-year-old woman at 11 weeks gestation in her second pregnancy is found to have a hemoglobin (Hb) of 9.0 g/dL, white blood cell count 6.3 x 109/L, platelet count 119 x 109/L, mean corpuscular volume 109 fL.
records.translation: 一名27歲女性，第二胎懷孕11週，檢驗發現血紅素（Hb）9.0 g/dL、白血球計數6.3 x 109/L、血小板計數119 x 109/L、平均紅血球體積109 fL。
records.back_translation: A 27-year-old woman, 11 weeks into her second pregnancy; tests find haemoglobin (Hb) 9.0 g/dL, white cell count 6.3 x 109/L, platelet count 119 x 109/L, mean corpuscular volume 109 fL.

records.source: Further investigations reveal mild iron deficiency.
records.translation: 進一步檢查顯示輕度缺鐵。
records.back_translation: Further tests show mild iron deficiency.

records.source: She already receives iron supplementation.
records.translation: 她已在接受鐵劑補充。
records.back_translation: She is already receiving iron supplements.

records.source: The obstetrician repeats the complete blood cell count 2 weeks later.
records.translation: 婦產科醫師於2週後重複全血球計數檢查。
records.back_translation: The obstetrician repeated the complete blood count 2 weeks later.

records.source: The Hb is 8.9 g/dL, WBC count 7.1 x 109/L, and platelets 108 x 109/L.
records.translation: Hb為8.9 g/dL，白血球計數7.1 x 109/L，血小板108 x 109/L。
records.back_translation: Hb 8.9 g/dL, white cell count 7.1 x 109/L, platelets 108 x 109/L.

records.source: She describes difficulty swallowing.
records.translation: 她描述有吞嚥困難。
records.back_translation: She describes difficulty swallowing.

records.source: A reticulocyte count is performed and found elevated at 180 x 109/L.
records.translation: 網狀紅血球計數檢查結果上升，為180 x 109/L。
records.back_translation: Reticulocyte count result raised, at 180 x 109/L.

records.source: The obstetrician requests a hematology consult.
records.translation: 婦產科醫師照會血液科。
records.back_translation: The obstetrician consults haematology.

records.source: The following additional results were found: Negative DAT, normal clotting screen, elevated LDH (2000 IU/L), normal urea and electrolytes, normal alanine aminotransferase (ALT), anisocytosis, poikilocytosis, no fragments, no agglutination, polychromasia and presence of hemosiderin in the urine.
records.translation: 另發現以下檢查結果：DAT陰性、凝血功能篩檢正常、LDH上升（2000 IU/L）、尿素及電解質正常、丙胺酸轉胺酶（ALT）正常、紅血球大小不均、紅血球形狀不均、無破碎紅血球、無凝集、多染性紅血球，以及尿液中有含鐵血黃素。
records.back_translation: The following further results were found: DAT negative, coagulation screen normal, LDH raised (2000 IU/L), urea and electrolytes normal, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normal, anisocytosis, poikilocytosis, no fragmented red cells, no agglutination, polychromatic red cells, and haemosiderin in the urine.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: Karen is a 72-year-old woman with hypertension and type 2 diabetes, who was hospitalized for cryptogenic stroke two weeks ago.
records.translation: Karen是一名72歲女性，患有高血壓及第2型糖尿病，兩週前因不明原因中風住院。
records.back_translation: Karen is a 72-year-old woman with hypertension and type 2 diabetes, admitted two weeks ago for stroke of unknown cause.

records.source: At the time, computed tomography was negative for brain hemorrhage and she was given thrombolytic therapy with resolution of her symptoms.
records.translation: 當時電腦斷層檢查未見腦出血，她接受血栓溶解治療後症狀緩解。
records.back_translation: At that time CT showed no brain haemorrhage; after thrombolytic treatment her symptoms resolved.

records.source: Transesophageal echocardiogram and magnetic resonance angiogram of brain and great vessels found no evidence of abnormalities.
records.translation: 經食道心臟超音波及腦部與大血管的磁振血管攝影均未發現異常。
records.back_translation: Transoesophageal echo and MR angiography of the brain and great vessels found no abnormality.

records.source: She presents currently with a blood pressure of 120/70 mm Hg, normal glucose, and normal sinus rhythm on a 12-lead electrocardiogram.
records.translation: 她目前就診時血壓120/70 mm Hg，血糖正常，12導程心電圖顯示正常竇性節律。
records.back_translation: At the current visit blood pressure 120/70 mm Hg, blood glucose normal, 12-lead ECG shows normal sinus rhythm.

records.source: She reports history of occasional palpitations, shortness of breath and chest pain lasting for a few minutes and then stopping on their own.
records.translation: 她表示曾偶有心悸、呼吸短促及胸痛，持續數分鐘後會自行停止。
records.back_translation: She says she has occasionally had palpitations, shortness of breath and chest pain, lasting a few minutes and then stopping by themselves.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 4 year old boy presents to the emergency room with wheezing.
records.translation: 一名4歲男童因喘鳴至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: A 4-year-old boy came to the emergency department for wheezing.

records.source: He has had a history of allergic rhinitis, but no history of wheezing.
records.translation: 他有過敏性鼻炎病史，但無喘鳴病史。
records.back_translation: He has a history of allergic rhinitis, but no history of wheezing.

records.source: His mother reports that 5 hours ago patient was playing in the backyard sandbox when she heard him suddenly start coughing.
records.translation: 他的母親表示，5小時前病童在後院沙坑玩耍時，她聽到他突然開始咳嗽。
records.back_translation: His mother says that 5 hours ago, while the child was playing in the backyard sandpit, she heard him suddenly start coughing.

records.source: The coughing lasted only moments, but he has been audibly wheezing since.
records.translation: 咳嗽只持續片刻，但此後一直可聽到明顯的喘鳴聲。
records.back_translation: The cough lasted only a moment, but since then an obvious wheeze can be heard all along.

records.source: Mother was concerned, because his breathing has not returned to normal, so she brought him to the ED.
records.translation: 母親因他的呼吸一直未恢復正常而擔心，於是帶他到急診。
records.back_translation: The mother was worried because his breathing had not returned to normal, so she brought him to the emergency department.

records.source: On exam, the child is playful and well appearing.
records.translation: 檢查時病童活潑好動，外觀良好。
records.back_translation: On examination the child is lively and active and looks well.

records.source: Wheezing is heard in the mid-right chest area.
records.translation: 右側中胸部可聞喘鳴音。
records.back_translation: Wheeze can be heard in the right mid-chest.

records.source: O2 sats are 100% on room air.
records.translation: 未使用氧氣下血氧飽和度為100%。
records.back_translation: Oxygen saturation 100% without oxygen.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 32 year old female with no previous medical history presents to clinic to discuss lab results from her most recent pap smear.
records.translation: 一名32歲女性，過去無任何病史，至門診討論最近一次子宮頸抹片的檢驗結果。
records.back_translation: A 32-year-old woman with no past history came to the clinic to discuss the result of her most recent cervical smear.

records.source: She reports no complaints and is in general good health.
records.translation: 她表示無任何不適，整體健康狀況良好。
records.back_translation: She reports no discomfort; overall health good.

records.source: The results of her PAP were cytology negative, HPV positive.
records.translation: 她的子宮頸抹片結果為細胞學陰性、HPV陽性。
records.back_translation: Her cervical smear result was cytology negative, HPV positive.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 65 yo African-American male with shortness of breath related to exertion that has been worsening over the past three weeks.
records.translation: 一名65歲非裔美籍男性，有與活動相關的呼吸短促，過去三週逐漸惡化。
records.back_translation: A 65-year-old African-American man with activity-related shortness of breath, gradually worsening over the past three weeks.

records.source: He also has difficulty breathing when lying flat and has started using two to three extra pillows at night.
records.translation: 他平躺時也會呼吸困難，晚上已開始需要多墊兩到三個枕頭。
records.back_translation: He also has dyspnoea when lying flat, and at night has started to need two to three extra pillows.

records.source: Significant physical exam findings include bibasilar lung crackles, pitting ankle edema and jugular venous distension.
records.translation: 重要理學檢查發現包括兩側肺底囉音、腳踝凹陷性水腫及頸靜脈怒張。
records.back_translation: Important physical findings include bibasal crackles, pitting ankle oedema and jugular venous distension.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 66yo female with significant smoking history and chronic cough for the past two years presents with recent, progressive shortness of breath.
records.translation: 一名66歲女性，有明顯抽菸史及過去兩年的慢性咳嗽，因近期進行性呼吸短促就醫。
records.back_translation: A 66-year-old woman with a notable smoking history and chronic cough for the past two years came for recent progressive shortness of breath.

records.source: She is in moderate respiratory distress after walking from the waiting room to the examination room.
records.translation: 她從候診室走到診間後即出現中度呼吸窘迫。
records.back_translation: After walking from the waiting room to the consulting room she develops moderate respiratory distress.

records.source: Physical exam reveals mildly distended neck veins, a barrel-shaped chest, and moderate inspiratory and expiratory wheezes.
records.translation: 理學檢查發現頸靜脈輕度怒張、桶狀胸，以及中度吸氣及吐氣喘鳴音。
records.back_translation: Physical examination finds mild jugular venous distension, barrel chest, and moderate inspiratory and expiratory wheezes.

records.source: She has smoked 1 to 2 packs per days for the past 47 years.
records.translation: 她過去47年來每天抽1至2包菸。
records.back_translation: She has smoked 1 to 2 packs a day for the past 47 years.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: An 89-year-old man was brought to the emergency department by his wife and son after six months of progressive changes in cognition and personality.
records.translation: 一名89歲男性因六個月來認知及人格進行性改變，由妻子及兒子帶至急診。
records.back_translation: An 89-year-old man was brought to the emergency department by his wife and son because of progressive changes in cognition and personality over six months.

records.source: He began to have poor memory, difficulty expressing himself, and exhibited unusual behaviors, such as pouring milk onto the table and undressing immediately after getting dressed.
records.translation: 他開始出現記憶力差、表達困難，並有異常行為，例如把牛奶倒在桌上，以及穿好衣服後立刻又脫掉。
records.back_translation: He began to have poor memory and difficulty expressing himself, with unusual behaviours such as pouring milk on the table, and undressing immediately after dressing.

records.source: He is unable to dress, bathe, use the toilet, or walk independently.
records.translation: 他無法獨立穿衣、洗澡、如廁或行走。
records.back_translation: He cannot dress, bathe, use the toilet or walk independently.

records.source: On examination the patient's temperature was 36.5C (97.7F), the heart rate 61 bpm in an irregular rhythm, the blood pressure 144/78 mm Hg, and the respiratory rate 18 bpm.
records.translation: 檢查時患者體溫36.5C（97.7F），心跳61 bpm且節律不規則，血壓144/78 mm Hg，呼吸速率18 bpm。
records.back_translation: On examination temperature 36.5C (97.7F), heart rate 61 bpm with irregular rhythm, blood pressure 144/78 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18 bpm.

records.source: The patient was alert and oriented to self and city but not year.
records.translation: 患者意識清醒，對人及所在城市有定向感，但對年份無定向感。
records.back_translation: The patient is alert, oriented to person and city, but not oriented to year.

records.source: He frequently interrupted the examiner.
records.translation: 他經常打斷檢查者說話。
records.back_translation: He often interrupted the examiner.

records.source: He repeatedly reached out to grab things in front of him, including the examiner's tie and face.
records.translation: 他一再伸手抓取面前的東西，包括檢查者的領帶及臉。
records.back_translation: He repeatedly reached out to grab things in front of him, including the examiner's tie and face.

records.source: He could not spell the word "world" backward, could not follow commands involving multiple steps and was unable to perform simple calculations.
records.translation: 他無法倒著拼出「world」這個字，無法遵從多步驟指令，也無法進行簡單計算。
records.back_translation: He could not spell the word "world" backwards, could not follow multi-step commands, and could not do simple calculations.

records.source: His speech was fluent, but he often used similar-sounding word substitutions.
records.translation: 他說話流暢，但經常以發音相近的字詞替代。
records.back_translation: His speech is fluent, but he often substitutes words with similar sounds.

records.source: He could immediately recall three out of three words but recalled none of them after 5 minutes.
records.translation: 他能立即回憶三個字中的三個，但5分鐘後一個也想不起來。
records.back_translation: He could immediately recall three of three words, but after 5 minutes could not recall a single one.

records.source: Examination of the cranial nerves revealed clinically significant paratonic rigidity.
records.translation: 腦神經檢查顯示具臨床意義的副張力性僵硬（paratonic rigidity）。
records.back_translation: Cranial nerve examination shows clinically significant paratonic rigidity.

records.source: Myoclonic jerks were seen in the arms, with symmetrically brisk reflexes.
records.translation: 雙上肢可見肌躍性抽動，雙側反射對稱性亢進。
records.back_translation: Myoclonic jerks seen in both upper limbs; reflexes symmetrically brisk on both sides.

records.source: The reflexes in the legs were normal.
records.translation: 雙下肢反射正常。
records.back_translation: Reflexes of both lower limbs normal.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 32-year-old male presents to your office complaining of diarrhea, abdominal cramping and flatulence.
records.translation: 一名32歲男性至您的診所就醫，主訴腹瀉、腹部絞痛及脹氣。
records.back_translation: A 32-year-old man came to your clinic complaining of diarrhoea, abdominal cramps and bloating/flatulence.
records.what_differs: keeps the textbook second person 'your office' (您的診所)
records.proposed_correction: 一名32歲男性至門診就醫，主訴腹瀉、腹部絞痛及脹氣。

records.source: Stools are greasy and foul-smelling.
records.translation: 糞便油膩且有惡臭。
records.back_translation: Stools greasy and foul-smelling.

records.source: He also has loss of appetite and malaise.
records.translation: 他也有食慾不振及全身倦怠。
records.back_translation: He also has loss of appetite and generalised malaise.

records.source: He recently returned home from a hiking trip in the mountains where he drank water from natural sources.
records.translation: 他最近從山區健行返家，健行期間曾飲用天然水源的水。
records.back_translation: He recently came home from a mountain hike, during which he drank water from natural sources.

records.source: An iodine-stained stool smear revealed ellipsoidal cysts with smooth, well-defined walls and 2+ nuclei.
records.translation: 碘染色糞便抹片發現橢圓形囊體，囊壁平滑、界線清楚，並有2個以上的細胞核。
records.back_translation: Iodine-stained stool smear found ellipsoidal cysts, with smooth, well-defined walls and 2 or more nuclei.

records.source: A 65-year-old male with a history of tuberculosis has started to complain of productive cough with tinges of blood.
records.translation: 一名65歲男性，有肺結核病史，開始主訴有帶血絲的濕咳。
records.back_translation: A 65-year-old man with a history of pulmonary tuberculosis has begun to complain of wet cough with streaks of blood.
records.what_differs: 'tuberculosis' becomes 肺結核 (pulmonary tuberculosis); the source does not name the site
records.proposed_correction: 一名65歲男性，有結核病病史，開始主訴有帶血絲的濕咳。

records.source: Chest X-ray reveals a round opaque mass within a cavity in his left upper lobe.
records.translation: 胸部X光顯示左上肺葉一空洞內有圓形不透光腫塊。
records.back_translation: Chest X-ray shows a round opaque mass inside a cavity in the left upper lobe.

records.source: The spherical mass moved in the cavity during supine and prone CT imaging.
records.translation: 仰臥及俯臥電腦斷層影像中，該球形腫塊會在空洞內移動。
records.back_translation: On supine and prone CT images, the spherical mass moves within the cavity.

records.source: Culture of the sputum revealed an organism with septated, low-angle branching hyphae that had straight, parallel walls.
records.translation: 痰液培養發現一種具有分隔、低角度分枝菌絲的微生物，菌絲壁平直且平行。
records.back_translation: Sputum culture found an organism with septate, low-angle branching hyphae, the hyphal walls straight and parallel.

records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: An 18-year-old male returning from a recent vacation in Asia presents to the ER with a sudden onset of high fever, chills, facial flushing, epistaxis and severe headache and joint pain.
records.translation: 一名18歲男性最近從亞洲度假返回，因突發高燒、畏寒、臉部潮紅、流鼻血、劇烈頭痛及關節痛至急診就醫。
records.back_translation: An 18-year-old man recently back from a holiday in Asia came to the emergency department for sudden high fever, chills, facial flushing, nosebleed, severe headache and joint pain.

records.source: His complete blood count reveals leukopenia, increased hematocrit concentration and thrombocytopenia.
records.translation: 全血球計數顯示白血球低下、血球容積比上升及血小板低下。
records.back_translation: Complete blood count shows low white cells, raised haematocrit and low platelets.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.

records.source: A 31 yo male with no significant past medical history presents with productive cough and chest pain.
records.translation: 一名31歲男性，無明顯過去病史，因濕咳及胸痛就醫。
records.back_translation: A 31-year-old man with no notable past history came for wet cough and chest pain.

records.source: He reports developing cold symptoms one week ago that were improving until two days ago, when he developed a new fever, chills, and worsening cough.
records.translation: 他表示一週前出現感冒症狀，原本逐漸好轉，直到兩天前出現新的發燒、畏寒及咳嗽加劇。
records.back_translation: He says cold symptoms appeared a week ago and were gradually getting better, until two days ago a new fever, chills and worsening cough appeared.

records.source: He has right-sided chest pain that is aggravated by coughing.
records.translation: 他有右側胸痛，咳嗽時會加劇。
records.back_translation: He has right-sided chest pain that worsens on coughing.

records.source: His wife also had cold symptoms a week ago but is now feeling well.
records.translation: 他的妻子一週前也有感冒症狀，但目前已康復。
records.back_translation: His wife also had cold symptoms a week ago but has now recovered.

records.source: Vitals signs include temperature 103.4, pulse 105, blood pressure 120/80, and respiratory rate 15.
records.translation: 生命徵象包括體溫103.4、脈搏105、血壓120/80、呼吸速率15。
records.back_translation: Vital signs include temperature 103.4, pulse 105, blood pressure 120/80, respiratory rate 15.

records.source: Lung exam reveals expiratory wheezing, decreased breath sounds, and egophany in the left lower lung field.
records.translation: 肺部檢查發現左下肺野有吐氣喘鳴音、呼吸音減弱及羊鳴音。
records.back_translation: Lung examination finds expiratory wheeze, reduced breath sounds and egophony in the left lower lung field.

records.source: The patient will provide informed consent, and will comply with the trial protocol without any practical issues.
records.translation: 患者將簽署受試者同意書，並能遵從試驗計畫書執行，無任何實務上的問題。
records.back_translation: The patient will sign the informed consent form and can follow the trial protocol, with no practical problems at all.
